name: Looney Tunes Collector’s Choice: Volumes 1–4
overview: A four-volume Warner Archive Collection series featuring 95 restored Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies theatrical shorts, plus two bonus cartoons. Released between 2023 and 2024, the series focuses primarily on cartoons that had never previously appeared on DVD or Blu-ray, spanning characters including Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Foghorn Leghorn, Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner.
